Role Overview

The Retail Expansion professional will be responsible for identifying suitable retail locations, conducting market research, evaluating properties, coordinating with landlords and property consultants, and supporting the end-to-end process of opening new stores. Key Responsibilities

* Source properties through brokers, landlords, property consultants, developers, and direct market research.
* Evaluate high-street locations, shopping malls, and other suitable retail spaces.
* Build and maintain a database of prospective properties and property owners.

* Conduct market visits to assess location suitability, footfall, visibility, accessibility, and surrounding brands.
* Analyse catchment areas, customer demographics, competition, and market potential.
* Evaluate commercial viability based on rental costs, store size, expected sales potential, and business requirements.

* Work with the legal and finance teams to review lease agreements, commercial terms, and supporting documentation.
* Track approvals, agreement execution, and other property-related formalities.
* Ensure property proposals are aligned with approved budgets and company policies.

**5. New Store Opening Coordination**

* Coordinate with Retail Operations, Projects, Design, Finance, Legal, and other internal teams to facilitate new store openings.
* Track property handover, fit-out readiness, utilities, permissions, and other location-related requirements.
* Monitor expansion timelines and proactively highlight potential delays.
* Support the end-to-end process from property identification to store handover.

**6. Reporting & Pipeline Management**

* Maintain an updated database of available properties, site visits, negotiations, and closures.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on the expansion pipeline.
* Track city-wise expansion targets, property acquisition costs, and closure timelines.
* Provide regular updates to management on progress, challenges, and upcoming opportunities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Real Estate, Marketing, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in retail expansion, commercial real estate, property acquisition, or business development.
* Strong negotiation and communication skills.

* Ability to conduct market research and assess property feasibility.
* Strong stakeholder management, follow-up, and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint for reporting and analysis.
* Willingness to travel for site visits and market assessments.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in retail, jewellery, fashion, lifestyle, D2C, or consumer brands.
* Existing network of property brokers, landlords, and commercial real estate consultants.
* Experience in high-street retail and shopping mall leasing.
* Exposure to multi-city retail expansion and new store openings.

A commercially aware and result-oriented professional with strong local market knowledge, negotiation skills, and the ability to identify profitable retail locations and drive new store expansion in line with PALMONAS's growth strategy.

title: Sr. Manager, Talent Acquisition (APAC)
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
Addepar is looking for a Sr. Manager, Talent Acquisition to lead our APAC recruiting function from our Pune, India office. This is a player-coach role: you will lead and develop a team of recruiters while also owning a portfolio of critical requisitions yourself, across our Go-to-Market (Sales & Services), R&D (Engineering, AI, Data, and Product), and G&A (Finance, Legal, People, IT) organizations.
  
  
You will act as the senior recruiting voice for the region, setting hiring strategy in partnership with regional and global leaders while staying close enough to the work to know exactly what's happening in the pipeline. You are comfortable operating in a matrix organization, balancing global talent acquisition standards with the realities of local markets, and you know how to translate broad company hiring goals into a concrete regional plan.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters across multiple functions, setting clear goals, providing regular feedback, and building a strong bench of recruiting talent in the region
* Personally own and manage a portfolio of high-priority, senior, or complex requisitions end to end, from intake through offer and close, across GTM, R&D, and G&A
* Set the APAC recruiting strategy in partnership with regional business leaders and global TA leadership, translating company-wide hiring goals into a regional plan that reflects local market realities
* Operate effectively in a matrix organization, balancing global process and standards with the needs of local hiring managers, functional leaders, and business units
* Partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders to understand their staffing needs, advise on hiring strategy, and build durable, trust-based relationships across the region
* Drive workforce planning conversations with business and People leaders, helping them think ahead of open reqs rather than react to them
* Bring a strong point of view on how AI and modern recruiting tools (sourcing, screening, scheduling, and candidate engagement) can improve speed, quality, and consistency across the team, and lead adoption of new tools and workflows
* Use recruiting metrics (time to fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, and more) to diagnose bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement across the funnel
* Ensure a consistently excellent, high-touch candidate experience, and represent Addepar's employer brand across APAC markets
* Stay current on employment law, hiring practices, and market compensation trends across the APAC countries in scope, ensuring recruiting activities remain compliant and competitive
* Partner with University Recruiting and campus programs where relevant to build long-term talent pipelines in the region

**Who You Are**

* 8-10+ years of progressive talent acquisition experience, including at least 5-7 years directly managing and developing a team of recruiters
* Proven experience recruiting across multiple functions (for example: GTM, R&D, and G&A/Corporate), not just a single specialty, with the range to flex between technical, commercial, and operational hiring
* Experience operating in a matrix or global organization, working across functional and geographic reporting lines and building consensus without formal authority over every stakeholder
* A genuine player-coach: equally comfortable setting strategy in the boardroom and getting into the details of a live requisition
* Strong track record using data and recruiting metrics to make decisions, tell a clear story to leadership, and hold the team accountable to outcomes
* Hands-on experience with AI-enabled recruiting tools and modern sourcing technology (for example: AI sourcing/screening tools, conversational scheduling, or GenAI-assisted workflows), with an eye for what's genuinely useful versus hype
* Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse preferred) and the broader recruiting tech stack
* Deep familiarity with APAC talent markets and the employment landscape across the relevant countries in scope; working knowledge of local employment law and compliance considerations
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior business leaders and adjust style across cultures and seniority levels
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Human Resources, Business, or a related field; MBA or relevant certification is a plus

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

About Indux Technology
  
  
Indux Technology is a technology-focused company delivering digital solutions and real-world technology projects. Our services include software development, website development, mobile applications, digital marketing, branding, CRM solutions, and business automation.
  
  
Our internship program is designed to provide students and freshers with practical exposure, professional work habits, team collaboration, and hands-on experience while contributing to real business initiatives.
  
  
About the Internship
  
  
We are looking for motivated and target-oriented candidates for the Sales & Marketing Intern position. This four-month remote internship is designed for candidates who want to develop practical skills in sales, marketing, lead generation, customer acquisition, and business development.
  
  
Interns will support customer acquisition through prospect research, lead generation, outreach, follow-ups, digital marketing, campaign execution, and sales support. They will also have the opportunity to contribute to business growth and earn commission on qualifying deals successfully closed through their efforts.
  
  
Role Description
  
  
As a Sales & Marketing Intern, you will work with the sales and marketing team to identify business opportunities, generate leads, communicate with prospective clients, promote company services, and support the sales process from initial contact to deal closure.
  
  
You will be expected to learn quickly, maintain professional communication, meet assigned targets, follow company processes, and take ownership of your responsibilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
- Identify target customers, industries, companies, and potential business opportunities.
  
- Generate leads through LinkedIn, email, social media, online research, and other channels.
  
- Assist with cold calling, cold emailing, LinkedIn outreach, and prospect follow-ups.
  
- Promote Indux Technology services and understand prospective clients' business requirements.
  
- Qualify leads and maintain accurate lead status and communication records.
  
- Schedule meetings and coordinate with prospects and the sales team.
  
- Support the preparation of sales presentations, proposals, quotations, and marketing materials.
  
- Assist with social media marketing, digital campaigns, and activities that contribute to lead generation.
  
- Research competitors, customer needs, market trends, and new business opportunities.
  
- Maintain CRM records and track outreach, follow-ups, meetings, conversions, and outcomes.
  
- Collaborate with sales, marketing, content, design, and technical teams.
  
- Follow up with qualified prospects and support negotiations and deal closure.
  
- Contribute to customer acquisition, revenue generation, and overall business growth.
  
- Maintain professional communication and represent the company appropriately.
  
  
Skills & Requirements
  
  
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  
- Interest in sales, marketing, business development, and technology.
  
- Basic understanding of lead generation, customer acquisition, and digital platforms.
  
- Familiarity with LinkedIn, email, CRM tools, and social media is preferred.
  
- Good research, follow-up, organization, and relationship-building skills.
  
- Confidence in communicating with prospective clients professionally.
  
- Target-oriented, proactive, disciplined, and willing to learn.
  
- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  
- Students and freshers are welcome to apply.
  
  
Performance Expectations
  
  
- Complete assigned tasks consistently and maintain acceptable work quality.
  
- Meet assigned outreach, lead generation, follow-up, and other role-specific targets.
  
- Learn from feedback and demonstrate measurable improvement.
  
- Maintain professional communication and respond to team members on time.
  
- Demonstrate reliability, discipline, ownership, and adherence to deadlines.
  
- Maintain accurate records of leads, customer interactions, and deal progress.
  
- Contribute positively to team goals and take initiative when appropriate.
  
- Demonstrate consistent performance and a willingness to contribute to business growth.
  
  
Stipend, Commission & Continuation Structure

2. Commission-Based Earnings
  
  
Interns may be eligible to earn commission on qualifying deals successfully closed through leads generated or sales activities directly attributable to their efforts.
  
  
- Commission eligibility will depend on the intern's contribution to the deal and the company's approved commission policy.
  
- The applicable commission percentage or amount will depend on the project, deal value, and approved terms.
  
- Commission calculation, payment timelines, and other applicable conditions will be communicated by the company.
  
- Deal attribution and commission approval will be determined by the company based on its established process.
  
  
3. Performance-Based Continuation From Month 5
  
  
After completing four months, selected interns may be considered for continuation based on individual performance, target achievement, discipline, business requirements, and management approval.
  
  
Eligible candidates may receive a performance-based stipend of ₹1,000–₹15,000 per month, along with applicable deal-based commissions where approved.
  
  
Continuation and stipend eligibility are not guaranteed.
  
  
What You Can Gain

- Hands-on experience in lead generation, customer acquisition, and business development.
  
- Experience promoting technology services and communicating with business clients.

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
**About the role**

We're hiring a Growth Marketer to own the two engines that turn marketing spend into pipeline: organic visibility (SEO plus answer-engine and generative-engine optimisation, AEO/GEO) and paid campaign performance. You'll audit both, fix what leaks, scale what works, and be judged on qualified pipeline — not clicks, form fills or impressions.

**What you'll own**

You'll run two loops — organic and paid.

**Organic visibility: SEO, AEO and GEO**

* Measure how AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews) answer our buyers' questions, per market: are we cited, which sources they draw on, what they say about us, and which competitor wins the answer.
* Maintain the tracked prompt set across three buyer intents — discovery ("best X for Y"), alternatives ("alternatives to [competitor]") and sentiment ("[brand] reviews", "[brand] vs [competitor]") — built from observed queries, not guesses.
* Trace every negative or inaccurate AI answer to its root source (a review site, a directory listing, an employer-review page, a competitor page) and fix it there with dated, factual content.
* Ship content engineered to be quoted: answer-first pages, comparison and alternatives pages, FAQs with schema, and original data stories.
* Own technical readiness: structured data, llms.txt, AI-crawler rules, canonicals, redirects and page speed — spec the change, then verify it is live.
* Grow the off-site footprint AI engines trust: review-platform profiles and their category placement, consistent directory listings, tier-1 trade-media coverage, and disclosed community answers on forums like Reddit and Quora.

**Paid performance**

* Audit campaigns end to end — spend, then CRM contacts, MQLs, SQLs, opportunities and closed-won — and report true cost per SQL, per opportunity and per won deal next to the platform's own numbers.
* Find where junk leads enter (broad match, loose location settings, auto-generated ads, network expansion) and close each leak structurally, not one lead at a time.
* Read the account change history and attribute a shift in performance to a change only when timing and mechanism both support it.
* Keep bidding and conversion goals healthy: no low-volume goal running alone, staged goal migrations, budget raised in measured steps.
* Compare who is served, who clicks and who converts by age, device, audience segment and geography — then against who actually becomes pipeline.
* Publish a Stop / Start / Continue plan each cycle: what to kill, what to scale, and the one fix for each near miss.

**Measurement and operating rhythm**

* Own a weekly three-line scoreboard (organic clicks week on week, biggest losing pages, AI-citation movers) and a monthly full report.
* Keep GA4 key events, UTMs and CRM source fields clean enough that paid and organic results can be trusted.
* Write a predicted impact for every recommendation, then grade it honestly a month later.
* Brief and verify agencies against their contracted scope, measured on outcomes rather than activity counts.
* Build repeatable, AI-assisted workflows (LLMs, API connectors, light scripting) that turn manual audits into weekly routines.
* Work daily with sales development and sales so leads are routed, worked fast and fed back as quality signals.

**What you'll bring**

You've run both paid and organic yourself, hands on keyboard, and you can show what your work did to pipeline.

* 2-5 years in B2B growth, performance or SEO roles, at least two of them in B2B SaaS or another long-sales-cycle technology business.
* Hands-on Google Ads (Search, Demand Gen, YouTube) and LinkedIn Ads, accountable for a meaningful monthly budget.
* Strong technical SEO: Search Console, structured data, crawling and indexing, redirects and migrations. You can turn a crawl report into a spec a developer acts on.
* Working knowledge of AEO/GEO — how AI assistants choose and cite sources, and how to measure visibility across repeated prompt runs. You've run an AI-visibility audit, or can walk us through how you would.
* CRM fluency (HubSpot, Salesforce or similar): lifecycle stages, lead status, source fields and UTMs. You can build the report that ties spend to SQLs and deals.
* Analytical discipline: comfortable in GA4, spreadsheets and basic SQL, and clear on the difference between a change that coincided with a result and one that caused it.
* AI-native working habits: you already use LLMs, connectors and simple automations to run audits, reports and drafts — and you check what they produce.

**Nice to have**

* Marketing to industrial, logistics, automotive or other operations-heavy buyers, where the decision-maker is rarely the person searching.
* Multi-market experience across India and at least one of North America, the Middle East, Southeast Asia or the UK, including local search behaviour and non-English content.
* Python, Apps Script or similar for pulling APIs and automating reports.
* Experience with AI-visibility tools (Profound, Peec, Otterly, HubSpot AI Visibility or similar) and a view on when to build versus buy.
* Conversion-rate work: landing-page tests, session recordings and heatmaps (Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar).
* YouTube and video-led demand generation.
